newsitem.title: USA: Johnson & Higgins mulls sale or going public - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Johnson & Higgins mulls sale or going public - WSJ.

text.p: Johnson & Higgins is considering going public or selling itself for what analysts believe could be $1 billion, the Wall Street Journal said in its electronic edition Tuesday.

The report, citing people familiar with the matter, said the company has been talking to several companies about combinations, including Marsh & McLennan Cos and American International Group Inc, which is an insurance carrier.
The report said analysts believe one potential acquirer could be Britain's Sedgwick Group Plc.
Johnson & Higgins, the third largest insurance broker in the United States, has hired Morgan Stanley & Co to explore strategic options, the report said.
